slides.title: Russia offers to host Ethiopia–Eritrea talks
slides.body: Foreign Minister Lavrov said Moscow is ready to help, if both sides are interested.

slides.title: "Now, tomorrow, or the day after"
slides.body: Speaking on Oct 28, Lavrov said Russia will try to host and facilitate a meeting. A deputy minister made a similar offer on Oct 16.

slides.title: No reply yet
slides.body: Neither Ethiopia nor Eritrea has publicly said it will accept. No Abiy–Isaias meeting has been confirmed. Both leaders are in Russia for the Russia–Africa summit.

slides.title: Why ties are strained
slides.body: Ethiopia calls sovereign Red Sea access an existential issue. Eritrea sees that push as a threat to its sovereignty. Relations have cooled since the 2022 Pretoria deal.

slides.title: Support peaceful dialogue between neighbours.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
